skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and explain fundamental concepts of data structures and algorithms, including arrays, lists, stacks, queues, trees, graphs, sorting, and searching.
Design and implement algorithms, analyze and represent algorithms on various data structures.
Apply algorithms to solve problems and evaluate algorithm performance.
Work independently or collaboratively in groups, demonstrating responsibility and professional ethics.
Communicate effectively in written and oral forms, including presentations and reports.
Self-study and understand data structures and algorithms through reading materials and discussions.
